name: M7.Selection.lex_laws
statement: ∀ (m : ℕ), (∀ a : Fin m → ℤ, ¬ M7.Selection.lex a a) ∧ (∀ a b c : Fin m → ℤ, M7.Selection.lex a b → M7.Selection.lex b c → M7.Selection.lex a c)
guidance: Unfold the explicit first-differing-coordinate lex relation. For two witness indices i,j, split i<j,i=j,j<i; choose the earlier index and use preceding-coordinate equalities. At equal indices compose strict inequalities. Fin order trichotomy works even m=0. Return tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact statement and default limits.
